blurb: S & S Charters offers a variety of boating experiences including luxury sailing catamaran charters around destinations such as Hart Miller Island, Middle River, and the greater Chesapeake Bay. Their flagship vessel is a 'Best in Class' Cruisers Yacht combining cabin cruiser and bow rider features. They provide charters for special events like executive events, tours, birthdays, anniversaries, and wellness retreats.
extraNote: In light rain or forecast rain, cruises continue unless captain deems unsafe · Named tropical storm, hurricane, thunderstorm, high winds or low temps cause postponement and reschedule at no cost · Cancellation 15+ days before departure: refund minus $50 processing fee · Cancellation 14 days or less before departure: 50% refund · Reschedule 15+ days before departure: no fee · Reschedule less than 14 days before departure: $200 rescheduling fee · Captain and first mate crew rate $150/hour paid upfront at dock, cash preferred but not only accepted · Balance payment due no later than 3 business days before scheduled charter
